key_insight: HiFi-Inpaint demonstrates that leveraging product reference images with targeted alignment, multi-scale texture transfer, and fidelity-aware losses enables high-fidelity, detail-preserving inpainting for human-product images, producing realistic composed outputs that retain fine product details.
problem_solved: Generates realistic human-product images while preserving fine-grained product details (textures, logos, materials) during reference-based inpainting, addressing blurring, misalignment, and detail loss common in prior methods.
method: Reference-guided alignment module: registers and warps product reference features to the target context to ensure geometry and pose consistency.
Multi-scale detail-preserving synthesis: fuses high- and low-resolution features and transfers texture details from the reference into the inpainted region.
Fidelity-aware optimization: uses perceptual/feature-matching losses and adversarial discrimination focused on product regions to preserve fine detail and realism.
impact: Provides a practical approach for e-commerce and advertising pipelines that need realistic, editable human-product images; improves downstream tasks (visual search, virtual try-on, product presentation) by keeping product identity and detail intact.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing reference input, alignment module, multi-scale fusion, and final inpainted output

paper_title: HiFi-Inpaint: Towards High-Fidelity Reference-Based Inpainting for Generating Detail-Preserving Human-Product Images
paper_authors: Yichen Liu, Donghao Zhou, Jie Wang, Xin Gao, Guisheng Liu
